known_facts_book1: The fairy girl Ruler of the Land of Oz, who disappears from her royal palace in the night at the very start of the book.
Was warned by her own fairy instinct that danger threatened, rose from her couch and confronted Ugu in the act of stealing her magic.
Was silenced with a scarf thrown over her head, tied fast, pushed into the Magic Dishpan and carried to the wicker castle.
Was locked in a room, wept and scolded and threatened the Shoemaker, and so frightened him that he enchanted her out of his sight and hearing.
Is imprisoned inside a **golden peach pit**, at the heart of a solitary enchanted peach in the exact center of the Great Orchard — which Button-Bright eats.
Cannot be destroyed by any magic ever devised, which Ugu had learned from his ancestors' books, and cannot be made invisible against her will.
Is released when the Wizard pries the golden peach pit open with his pocket knife and a pink cloud-like haze pours out and takes her form.
Puts an emerald chain around the little Pink Bear's neck in thanks for the answers that led to her rescue.
Forbids all her subjects except Glinda and the Wizard to practice magic, and has everything of Ugu's — stolen and inherited alike — packed and carried away.
Was absent so long that Jellia Jamb's questions spread the news through the whole Emerald City, and her return is met by the entire city turned out to welcome her.

known_facts_book1: A little Kansas girl living in Ozma's palace, a Princess of Oz and the only one who dares seek Ozma in her royal apartments at any hour.
Is the first to discover that Ozma is missing, and the first to find the Magic Picture gone from behind its satin curtains.
Wears the Magic Belt she once captured from the Nome King, which protects her from all harm.
Secretly experiments with the Belt all through the journey and discovers two things her friends do not know: that it can perform transformations, and that it grants its wearer **one wish a day**.
The daily wish requires closing the right eye, wiggling the left big toe, drawing a long breath and wishing; she had spent one on a box of caramels the day before.
Uses the saved wish to right the upside-down hall of the wicker castle, freeing the whole party from Ugu's trap.

Transforms Ugu into a dove by pressing both hands to the Magic Belt and commanding it — but she had meant to say 'Dove of Peace' and in her excitement said only 'dove', so the bird is a spiteful Dove of War.
Shrinks the attacking dove to the size of a canary with a second use of the Belt, which is what drives Ugu to flee in the dishpan.
Had tested the transformation power in secret at night, turning the Sawhorse into a potato masher and the Cowardly Lion into a pussycat and back again.
Forgives Ugu at the very end and offers to restore his man's shape, which he refuses.
